entries.title: Proverbs 14:1
segments: ¶The wisdom of women buildeth their house; but folly plucketh it down with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:2
segments: ¶He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; but he that is perverted in his ways despiseth him.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:3
segments: ¶In the fool's mouth is a rod of pride; but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:4
segments: ¶Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:5
segments: ¶A faithful witness will not lie; but a false witness uttereth lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:6
segments: ¶A scorner seeketh wisdom, and there is none [for him]; but knowledge is easy unto the intelligent.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:7
segments: ¶Go from the presence of a foolish man, in whom thou perceivest not the lips of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:8
segments: ¶The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way; but the folly of the foolish is deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:9
segments: ¶Fools make a mock at trespass; but for the upright there is favour.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:10
segments: ¶The heart knoweth its own bitterness, and a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:11
segments: ¶The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; but the tent of the upright shall flourish.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:12
segments: ¶There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof is the ways of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:13
segments: ¶Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful, and the end of mirth is sadness.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:14
segments: ¶The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways, and the good man from what is in himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:15
segments: ¶The simple believeth every word; but the prudent [man] heedeth his going.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:16
segments: ¶A wise [man] feareth and departeth from evil; but the foolish is overbearing and confident.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:17
segments: ¶He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly, and a man of mischievous devices is hated.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:18
segments: ¶The simple inherit folly; but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:19
segments: ¶The evil bow before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous [man].

entries.title: Proverbs 14:20
segments: ¶He that is poor is hated even of his own neighbour; but the rich hath many friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:21
segments: ¶He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth; but he that is gracious to the afflicted, happy is he.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:22
segments: ¶Do they not err that devise evil? but loving-kindness and truth are for those that devise good.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:23
segments: ¶In all labour there is profit; but the talk of the lips [tendeth] only to want.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:24
segments: ¶The crown of the wise is their riches; the folly of the foolish is folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:25
segments: ¶A true witness delivereth souls; but deceit uttereth lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:26
segments: ¶In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:27
segments: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, to turn away from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:28
segments: ¶In the multitude of people is the king's glory; but in the lack of people is the ruin of a prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:29
segments: ¶He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:30
segments: ¶A sound heart is the life of the flesh; but envy the rottenness of the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:31
segments: ¶He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; but he that honoureth Him is gracious to the needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:32
segments: ¶The wicked is driven away by his evil-doing; but the righteous trusteth, [even] in his death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:33
segments: ¶Wisdom resteth in the heart of the intelligent [man]; but that which is in the foolish maketh itself known.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:34
segments: ¶Righteousness exalteth a nation; but sin is a reproach to peoples.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:35
segments: ¶The king's favour is toward a wise servant; but his wrath is [against] him that causeth shame.
